title: What to do on weekend
simplified_paragraphs: 周末又到了，朋友问我要做什么，我说不知道。旅游不行，只有两天，时间太短。打球和跑步不行，天气太热。学习语言，但是每个星期学5天汉语，周末我不想学了。妈妈想去商店买东西，但是我不想买东西，也不喜欢去商店。做什么呢？还是在家睡觉吧！
traditional_paragraphs: 週末又到了，朋友問我要做什麼，我說不知道。旅遊不行，只有兩天，時間太短。打球和跑步不行，天氣太熱。學習語言，但是每個星期學5天漢語，週末我不想學了。媽媽想去商店買東西，但是我不想買東西，也不喜歡去商店。做什麼呢？還是在家睡覺吧！
pinyin_paragraphs: zhōu mò yòu dào le， péng you wèn wǒ yào zuò shén me， wǒ shuō bù zhī dào。 lǚ yóu bù xíng， zhǐ yǒu liǎng tiān， shí jiān tài duǎn。 dǎ qiú hé pǎo bù bù xíng， tiān qì tài rè。 xué xí yǔ yán， dàn shì měi gè xīng qī xué 5 tiān Hàn yǔ， zhōu mò wǒ bù xiǎng xué le。 mā ma xiǎng qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xi， dàn shì wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi dōng xi， yě bù xǐ huan qù shāng diàn。 zuò shén me ne？ hái shi zài jiā shuì jiào ba！
english_paragraphs: The weekend is here again. A friend asked me what I was going to do, and I said I didn't know. Traveling is out—there are only two days, and that's too short. Playing ball or going for a run is out too; it's too hot. I could study a language, but I study Chinese five days a week, and I don't want to study on the weekend. Mom wants to go shopping, but I don't want to buy anything, and I don't like going to stores. What should I do? I might as well stay home and sleep!
english_full: The weekend is here again. A friend asked me what I was going to do, and I said I didn't know. Traveling is out—there are only two days, and that's too short. Playing ball or going for a run is out too; it's too hot. I could study a language, but I study Chinese five days a week, and I don't want to study on the weekend. Mom wants to go shopping, but I don't want to buy anything, and I don't like going to stores. What should I do? I might as well stay home and sleep!
